_comment: Territory wars (DESIGN section 5, Phase 11). Points = the 3 contested shrines (zones.json) plus the outposts below; outposts are contested zones too (always-on PvP). Points only change hands during a war (wars: UTC start hour + minutes, every day). Capture: living players of one side inside captureRadius push the meter; strength = min(maxStrength, more players than the other side), a full capture by one player takes captureSeconds. The holder's own players refill it; a point the attackers drain to 0 turns neutral, then fills toward them. With nobody inside, a half-taken meter drifts back at decayScale. The faction with the most capturers takes it; their crew (if any) gets the income every incomeEveryMinutes.
_buffs: Held shrines give the holding faction's members a bonus everywhere: dmg = outgoing bending damage, regen = chi regeneration, armor = damage taken reduced. Every held point also adds xpPerPoint XP for the holding faction.
_warband: Faction NPCs fight at every point during a war: `perSide` fighters for each side (the holder's own faction defends; attackers come from the other side's factions in turn). They attack players of the other side and don't count toward captures.
_plots: Crew base plots: a crew claims a free plot by raising its crew hall within plotRadius of the plot centre. The ground is levelled within flatRadius.
